rca_of_the_issue.duplicate_warning_not_visible:
Backend GET /api/patients/check-duplicate?mobile=9988776600 returns Rajesh Kumar's record correctly (confirmed via pytest test_duplicate_check_by_mobile). But when the same mobile is typed into [data-testid='in-mobile'] on the New Patient form, no warning banner appears in the DOM after 1.5s. Likely cause: the onChange handler either does not invoke the API, invokes it but does not store the response in a rendered state variable, or the warning block is conditionally rendered with a boolean that is never set to true. Fix: add `useEffect` on `mobile` (debounced 500-800ms) → `axios.get('/api/patients/check-duplicate', { params: { mobile } })` → setDupMatches(res.data) → render banner `{dupMatches?.length > 0 &&
Duplicate found: {dupMatches[0].name} ({dupMatches[0].patient_id})
}`.
